name: wuji1hr-float-p1
summary: Floating Wuji Hand 1 (through the multihand retargeter path) (existing stack; spec is descriptive only) on the official 6-DoF floating wrist, no arm: HUG's wrist pose executed by protocol mano-1111-p1's evaluator with the MANO capsule hand replaced; fingers and the hand-root mount from rl/sim/multihand/retarget.HandRetargeter (the retargeter of the table-arm results on this hand) fitted on HUG's predicted landmarks. New benchmark version (2026-11-19).

base.name: mano-1111-p1
base.note: scene, table plane, wrist trajectory (GraspPlanConfig defaults), lift and final-frame table-contact test are the base protocol's; handoff A2 as tools/float/collab_native.Harness.bench_handoff

source.port: tools/ex210_1112/hbport210.py at commit db7ee7177 (EX210 harness port v2, 2026-11-12), itself the frozen October Wuji evaluator (tools/float_wuji/wuji_eval.py) with the hand generalised
source.changes: tools/float_hands/hand_eval.py: the composed scene cached per object and compiled per grasp with the mount (a fresh compile, because dampratio is fixed into kv at compile time and mj_setConst does not update it); handoff A2 on the compiled table height; the frozen evaluator's keyframe order; no hull-vertex cap; host paths from the environment or the base protocol; diagnostics; tools/float_hands/rollout_hand.py: handoff A2, validity, stages, pool (as tools/float_wuji/rollout_wuji.py). With hand = Wuji 1, the frozen glove fit and the frozen mount, this code reproduces EX292's 200 reference labels and final object heights bit for bit (2026-11-19 20:4x, reference host A)

retargeter.method: the table-arm pipeline's 4r retarget gate (tools/float_hands/fit4r.py = tools/ex207_1111/s4r207 fit207, bit-equal by test): rl/sim/multihand/retarget.HandRetargeter.fit, root pose (6) and every actuator target solved jointly by least squares on the 21 MANO keypoint positions in the evaluator world (scipy least_squares, bounds = the compiled joint ranges, max_nfev 400, tolerances 1e-10); when its fingertip RMS error exceeds 10 mm, a refit from 5 starts (rotation offsets 0 and +-30 deg about the palm z and x axes) keeping the lowest cost; a final fingertip error above 10 mm = 'not retargetable', a failure not rolled out (stage invalid_input, not_retargetable = 1)
retargeter.palm_init_note: the fit's initial root orientation and orientation prior = the MANO wrist rotation times this matrix (the frozen Wuji evaluator's fixed MANO-wrist -> Wuji-palm rotation R_c @ OPERATOR2MANO_RIGHT @ Rrot^T; wuji-retargeting e3636d6 glove config; computed on reference host A 2026-11-19)
retargeter.open_pose: the fit of the official MANO start pose (flat hand, thumb base pre-bend 1.0 rad on x and y), root at identity with the palm init rotation
retargeter.closing_direction: HandRetargeter.closing_sign: +1 when increasing the actuator moves its fingertip toward the palm normal at the open pose

wrist.note: the official wrist of the evaluator; gravity acts on the hand (no compensation)

hand_contact.note: the frozen Wuji evaluator's mapping of the MANO capsule hand's contact values; vendor per-geom contact values are replaced

physics.hand_model_edits: rl/sim/multihand/handspec_build.load_hand_spec with its hull-vertex cap undone (maxhullvert -1: hulls as MuJoCo computes them, as the frozen Wuji evaluator; the cap changes qhull's output even where it does not bind); deleted joints [], deleted actuators []; vendor actuators, keyframes and force limits not used
physics.close_rule: lerp endpoint = fit backed off <= 0.2 rad toward the open pose on the flexion actuators of fingers 2-5 (closing direction per actuator) and on each thumb actuator; goal = fit + 0.1 rad on the same flexion actuators; abduction / rotation actuators keep the fit; targets clipped to the ranges (GraspPlanConfig finger_pre_curl_rad / finger_extra_curl_rad)
physics.mount: T_wrist_root = T_world_wrist^-1 T_world_root of the fit, set per grasp as the root body's pos / quat inside the wrist body, with a fresh compile per grasp (dampratio becomes the actuator damping kv at compile time and mj_setConst does not update it); the wrist plan (pre-grasp offset, lift) moves the hand rigidly as MANO's wrist
physics.handoff_table_height: handoff A2 places the object on the compiled scene's table plane (compose_scene writes its height with 6 significant digits), as the frozen evaluator's harness
physics.object_contact: the object's collision geoms take the hand default solref 0.04 1 / solimp 0.5 0.95 0.001, as the include of the hand file gives them in the MANO and frozen Wuji scenes (fixed 2026-11-19, 595b88704, after EX327's dry reproduction check found 90 % agreement without it)
physics.close_rule_order: the back-off is computed from the unclipped targets and every keyframe is clipped at the end, as tools/float_wuji/wuji_eval.finger_keyframes
physics.scene_mask: object and table geoms accept the hand's contype bits

labels.success_native: no contact between the table plane and any object geom at the final frame (t = 4.0 s, after the 0.5 m lift) and a valid simulation (finite state, no BADQACC warning during the rollout); as mano-1111-p1
labels.success_strict_v1: native success AND the final-frame hand-object contact includes the thumb (finger 1 of rl/sim/multihand/specs: bodies ['right_finger1_']*) and at least one other finger AND final object rise >= 400 mm; the mano-1111-p1 definition with the fingers mapped by the spec's body prefixes (1 thumb, 2 index, 3 middle, 4 ring, 5 little; palm = ['right_palm_link'] and the wrist body)
labels.october_rule: the evaluator's own flag (not on the ground at the final frame, no validity check); diagnostic only

digest_rule: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators ',' ':') of {name, base_digest, hand_name, code, hand, retargeter{files}}
